blockers.detail: agents/src/trader/ does not exist. Only the Firefly orbital-mission pipeline (agents/src/firefly/) is present. The trader CLI (trader scan / trader research) is not implemented. The daily-trader task was configured before the pipeline was built.

Outbound HTTPS to finance.yahoo.com is blocked by the remote-execution proxy (CONNECT tunnel 403). yfinance installed successfully but every ticker returned 'curl: (7) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. Cannot fetch realised price data or run backtests without an alternative data source.

fallback_mode: TRADER_OFFLINE stub — no LLM scan, no price data

remediation.B1: Implement agents/src/trader/ pipeline (orchestrator, schemas, news_scout, thesis generator, sizing agent) and register `trader` CLI entry-point in agents/pyproject.toml.
remediation.B2: Either (a) allowlist finance.yahoo.com / query1.finance.yahoo.com in the proxy config, or (b) switch to an alternative data source accessible from the remote env (e.g. Alpha Vantage, Polygon.io, or a HTTPS-proxied yfinance mirror).
